-- Readiness receipts and their replay keys are mutable Planner-owned
-- lifecycle evidence attached to an otherwise immutable published Step.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION practice_runtime_instance_frozen_steps(payload JSONB) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(step_object - 'status' - 'readiness_receipt' - 'readiness_idempotency_key' ORDER BY ordinal), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(payload->'steps','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS step(step_object,ordinal)
$$;
